label: accepted

evidence.V1: Stair flight with twin stringers reads instantly in front, three-quarter, top and silhouette (stepped notch plus raised stringer posts).
evidence.V2: Big mass and medium treads/stringers are clear, but there is no small tier: the large side faces of the stringers are blank flat slabs, with no capstones, studs or end detail.
evidence.V3: Built from plain boxes (box stringers, slab treads, a vertical riser block); it is tidy but stiff, with no exaggeration, taper or overhang play.
evidence.V4: Treads, stringer caps and posts all have the same small chamfer and it catches light evenly (close_steps_studio).
evidence.V5: Close-ups are clean, with no pinches, z-fighting or stray faceting; only hairline anti-alias seams between shells show in the silhouette.
evidence.V6: One stone hue in three values (tread light/dark checker, darker risers and side faces); the colourways stay disciplined.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, smooth chamfered stone in the kit's grey values; it matches the modular stone set.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Default or a wedge, CanTouch off, white MeshPart, grid-corner pivot; T1 tiling passes.

artifacts: Hairline light seams between stair shells visible in silhouette render (cosmetic only)
top_fixes: Add small-tier detail: capstones or end blocks on the stringer posts and a block split or inset panel on the big flat stringer sides
Give the treads a slight nosing overhang past the riser so each step casts a shadow line
Vary tread slab sizes and offsets slightly so the light/dark checker feels less mechanical
